bio_en: Aram Yerkanian belonged to the chosen phalanx of the ARF's bold avengers. His daring and highly sensitive temperament was shaped in youth by the veterans Stepan Stepanian (Balajan), a member of Kukunian's expedition who escaped from Sakhalin, and Sargis Ohanjanian (Farhat). He became one of the circle around Misak Torlakian, Yervand Fndkian, Arshavir Shirakian and Grigor Amirian that hunted down the organisers of the Genocide and their collaborators after the war.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Specific operations not read in #391 (truncated); general knowledge links him to the killing of Khan Khoyski (1920) and of Behaeddin Shakir and Jemal Azmi (1922) - not used, verify.
